sources.public_adapter_equivalence: AST matches measured adapter after excluding the module provenance docstring; public formatting was verified AST-invariant
sources.current_c500_equivalence: After measurement, explanatory comments were added; executable AST verified unchanged against measured source. c500_source_sha256 retains the measured-source hash.

protocol.format: shape keys are batch x heads x KV tokens; configs: default=[head_tile,splits], dense=[head_tile,key_tile,splits], triton=[head_tile,key_tile,warps,splits]
protocol.input: contiguous FP16, one KV head, latent dimension512, positional dimension64; GPU torch.randn for final measurement
protocol.summary: median of six batch-average full-call wall samples
protocol.boundary: output/workspace allocations, all kernel launches, merge, batch-end synchronization; compilation and search excluded
protocol.order: all six permutations of the three implementations
protocol.tuning: Public C500 default; dense configs previously screened on C500; Triton staged tile/wave/split screening followed by full split rescreen for the selected layout and 1/2-wave probes. Finite search, not a global optimum claim.
